card.title: Director of Engineering and Manufacturing
card.description:
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Location:**
Export, Pennsylvania

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

www.kt-grant.com

**About the Role**

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on
**Director of Engineering and Manufacturing**
to lead the technical integrity, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement of our production facilities. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will bridge the gap between engineering innovation and shop-floor execution—overseeing complex manufacturing departments (including welding, machining, assembly, paint, and engineering) while driving job-level profitability, safety, and on-time delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational & Multi-Site Production Leadership**

* Direct daily manufacturing operations across multiple departments (welding, machine shop, assembly, paint, and engineering) to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and customer commitments.
* Establish and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), lean workflows, and best practices to optimize cycle times, equipment utilization, and project coordination.
* Drive job-level profitability by monitoring labor productivity, managing working capital in staging/WIP areas, and executing rigorous cost-control measures.
* Partner with the Safety department to enforce strict regulatory compliance and foster an ethical, safety-first shop-floor culture.

**Engineering Strategy & Technical Execution**

* Define and execute the long-term engineering vision while leading day-to-day activities across mechanical, electrical, and process engineering disciplines.
* Provide technical oversight across the entire product lifecycle—from concept, equipment schematics, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) through assembly and finished goods.
* Collaborate closely with Service and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot complex equipment (including hydraulic systems), manage preventative maintenance, and oversee rolling stock inventory.

**Financial Acumen & Strategic Growth**

* Partner with the CFO to formulate and manage annual Capital Expenditure (CapEx) and program budgets for manufacturing equipment and technology.
* Provide senior leadership with critical costing data and engineering value analyses to reduce Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and expand gross margins.
* Analyze industry trends and economic conditions to position our equipment design and production capabilities for long-term growth.

**Systems Integration & Supply Chain Collaboration**

* Lead the integration and optimization of ERP systems (such as SyteLine) and CAD tools (SolidWorks) into daily manufacturing workflows.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to forecast inventory needs, streamline purchase order flows, maintain material availability, and keep inventory days of supply low.

**Labor Relations & People Management**

* Partner with the Director of HR to manage workforce dynamics within a unionized environment, ensuring collective bargaining agreement compliance and resolving technical or scheduling disputes.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering and production talent.
* Establish and track production KPIs and performance dashboards to drive accountability, timely shop output, and continuous team development.



**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required:**

* **Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial, or Process Engineering (or a related engineering discipline).
* **Experience:**
 5–10+ years of progressive leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams (mechanical, electrical, industrial/process) and complex manufacturing operations within the heavy industrial or heavy metals sector.
* **Labor Relations:**
 Direct experience managing a unionized workforce and navigating collective bargaining agreements.
* **Technical & Systems Proficiency:**
 Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (SyteLine preferred), SolidWorks, KPI dashboards, Microsoft Office, and hydraulic equipment troubleshooting.
* **Financial & Regulatory Acumen:**
 Proven experience with CapEx budgeting, manufacturing cost accounting, COGS reduction, and regulatory compliance.
* **Leadership Traits:**
 Demonstrated ability to make rational, ethical decisions under pressure while balancing customer on-time delivery with shop-floor capacity.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s Degree in Engineering (MSE) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or Six Sigma / Lean certification

card.title: Director Supply Chain Operations
card.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Requisition Number** 37994

Summary:

The Operations Director provides strategic and operational leadership for system-wide Supply Chain operations, including logistics, distribution, inventory management, procedural support, supplier services, and Workday ERP initiatives. The role drives standardization, technology-enabled improvement, regulatory compliance, and reliable service across acute, ambulatory, and non-acute settings to support high-quality patient care.

Responsibilities:

1. Lead system-wide Supply Chain operations across logistics, warehousing, distribution, fleet, mailroom, equipment services, and acute, ambulatory, procedural, and non-acute inventory programs.
 
2. Serve as the operational lead for Supply Chain ERP initiatives, including Workday implementation and optimization, requirements analysis, data validation, configuration, enhancement requests, and operational readiness.
 
3. Develop and execute the Supply Chain operations vision, strategic plan, annual operating plan, standards, policies, and procedures in alignment with organizational objectives and best practices.
 
4. Lead and develop the Supply Chain operations team, promoting accountability, engagement, professional development, customer service, and continuous improvement.
 
5. Improve operational and financial performance through metrics, analytics, Lean Six Sigma, process standardization, automation, inventory optimization, labor productivity, cost reduction, and service-level improvement.
 
6. Manage supplier and service-provider performance, including vendor access and credentialing, product backorders and recalls, outsourced services, and improvement initiatives.
 
7. Collaborate with clinical, finance, information services, facilities, executive leadership, and other stakeholders to implement technology and operational solutions that improve visibility, decision-making, and organizational performance.
 
8. Ensure regulatory compliance, ethical operations, risk management, emergency preparedness, business continuity, and product shortage response in accordance with DNV, Joint Commission, CMS, OSHA, and other applicable requirements; perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Other information:

"1. Healthcare experience and advanced knowledge of logistics, warehousing, distribution, inventory management, procedural supply operations, and operational excellence.
 
2. Demonstrated expertise in ERP systems including implementation, optimization, testing, business process design, and change management.
 
3. Proficiency in Lean Six Sigma methodologies and continuous improvement principles.
 
4. Advanced data analytics capabilities with the ability to interpret operational and financial performance metrics.
 
5. Advanced Excel skills including complex data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
 
6. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels and facilitate cross-functional collaboration.
 
7. Proven expertise in project management, operational transformation, and leading large-scale organizational initiatives.
 
8. Working knowledge of supply chain automation technologies, inventory management systems, business intelligence tools, and healthcare operational best practices."

"Education: Bachelor's degree from a four-year accredited university or college required; master's degree highly preferred.

Certification: CMRP, CSCP, CPIM, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, RN, or another relevant credential preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressive supply chain, logistics, distribution, healthcare operations, or related experience required.

Supervisory Experience: Lean Six Sigma, operational excellence, or process improvement leadership experience preferred. Five years of leadership experience overseeing logistics, distribution, inventory management, warehouse operations, procedural supply operations, or related healthcare operational functions required."

Full Time

FTE: 1.000000

 
 

Status: Onsite

card.title: Director of Operations | Full-Time | Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
card.description:
Oak View Group:

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary:

In consultation with the General Manager, the **Director of Operations** directs the day-to-day operations of the complex, including but not limited to maintenance, setup/changeovers, custodial/housekeeping, equipment safety, and capital projects. This employee also provides overall administrative planning, direction, and policies to operating managers and supervisors, assuring the highest quality service program to ensure booking and rebooking of events. The Director of Operations ensures an effective and cost-efficient program by controlling the departmental operating budget while providing highly responsible staff assistance to the General Manager.

This role pays an annual salary of $80,000 - $88,000.

**Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays).**

**This position will remain open until February 19, 2027.**

Responsibilities:

* Direct overall daily operation and maintenance of the facility and all systems. This includes electrical, plumbing, fire protection, life safety, workplace safety, communications, scoreboard systems, pest control, custodial services, etc
* Participate in the development and administration of the facility’s operations and capital budgets; forecast additional funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials, and supplies; monitor and approve expenditures; implement adjustments as necessary
* Oversees the advancing and communicating of event information to the appropriate departments and staff
* Oversees the operation of event setup and teardown, i.e., basketball floor, stage risers, chairs, signs, banquet functions, etc
* Acts as liaison with City and County Services for numerous facility-related functions (city codes, parking, licenses, permits, inspections, warranties, etc.)
* Select, train, direct, motivate, and evaluate staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline and termination procedures
* Responsible for health & safety compliance
* Develop and update comprehensive management reports and manuals (i.e., Operations Manual, Annual Preventative Maintenance Plan, Annual Facility Report, Fire Code Rules & Regulations, etc.)
* Demonstrate continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide quality seamless customer service
* Conduct a variety of organizational and operational studies; recommend modifications to programs, policies, and procedures as appropriate
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, facility stakeholders, and facility users
* Direct and monitor the work of contractors, engineers, and architects on building projects
* Maintain a hazardous materials communication program and material safety data sheets; maintain knowledge of changes in pertinent federal, state, and local regulations
* All other duties as assigned by the General Manager

Qualifications:

* B.S. or B.A. degree from an accredited college/university is preferred.
* 5-7 years’ experience in facility operations management.
* Must show demonstrated knowledge of physical plant management, supervisory skills, and experience in work crew supervision in facility operations.
* Ability to work event nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Knowledge of budget preparation and control.
* Knowledge of OSHA requirements.
* Basic knowledge of boilers, chillers, refrigeration, and ice making.
* Basic Knowledge of Fire Alarms / Fire Protection Systems.
* Knowledge of event production and theater technology.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to communicate with employees, co-workers, volunteers, management staff, and guests in a clear, businesslike, and respectful manner, which focuses on generating a positive, enthusiastic, and cooperative work environment.
* Ability to work well in a team-oriented, fast-paced, event-driven environment.
* Working knowledge of equipment safety, facility maintenance, and housekeeping.
* Excellent customer service skills.

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference:

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

card.title: Director of Operations | Full-Time | Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
card.description:
Oak View Group:

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary:

In consultation with the General Manager, the **Director of Operations** directs the day-to-day operations of the complex, including but not limited to maintenance, setup/changeovers, custodial/housekeeping, equipment safety, and capital projects. This employee also provides overall administrative planning, direction, and policies to operating managers and supervisors, assuring the highest quality service program to ensure booking and rebooking of events. The Director of Operations ensures an effective and cost-efficient program by controlling the departmental operating budget while providing highly responsible staff assistance to the General Manager.

This role pays an annual salary of $80,000 - $88,000.

**Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays).**

**This position will remain open until February 19, 2027.**

Responsibilities:

* Direct overall daily operation and maintenance of the facility and all systems. This includes electrical, plumbing, fire protection, life safety, workplace safety, communications, scoreboard systems, pest control, custodial services, etc
* Participate in the development and administration of the facility’s operations and capital budgets; forecast additional funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials, and supplies; monitor and approve expenditures; implement adjustments as necessary
* Oversees the advancing and communicating of event information to the appropriate departments and staff
* Oversees the operation of event setup and teardown, i.e., basketball floor, stage risers, chairs, signs, banquet functions, etc
* Acts as liaison with City and County Services for numerous facility-related functions (city codes, parking, licenses, permits, inspections, warranties, etc.)
* Select, train, direct, motivate, and evaluate staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline and termination procedures
* Responsible for health & safety compliance
* Develop and update comprehensive management reports and manuals (i.e., Operations Manual, Annual Preventative Maintenance Plan, Annual Facility Report, Fire Code Rules & Regulations, etc.)
* Demonstrate continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide quality seamless customer service
* Conduct a variety of organizational and operational studies; recommend modifications to programs, policies, and procedures as appropriate
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, facility stakeholders, and facility users
* Direct and monitor the work of contractors, engineers, and architects on building projects
* Maintain a hazardous materials communication program and material safety data sheets; maintain knowledge of changes in pertinent federal, state, and local regulations
* All other duties as assigned by the General Manager

Qualifications:

* B.S. or B.A. degree from an accredited college/university is preferred.
* 5-7 years’ experience in facility operations management.
* Must show demonstrated knowledge of physical plant management, supervisory skills, and experience in work crew supervision in facility operations.
* Ability to work event nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Knowledge of budget preparation and control.
* Knowledge of OSHA requirements.
* Basic knowledge of boilers, chillers, refrigeration, and ice making.
* Basic Knowledge of Fire Alarms / Fire Protection Systems.
* Knowledge of event production and theater technology.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to communicate with employees, co-workers, volunteers, management staff, and guests in a clear, businesslike, and respectful manner, which focuses on generating a positive, enthusiastic, and cooperative work environment.
* Ability to work well in a team-oriented, fast-paced, event-driven environment.
* Working knowledge of equipment safety, facility maintenance, and housekeeping.
* Excellent customer service skills.

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference:

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
Explore opportunities with Amedisys, part of the Optum family of businesses. We provide home health, hospice and community-based services that help people receive quality care where they feel most comfortable: at home. Rooted in personalized care, we support patients and provide comfort through each stage of their health journey, while building trusted relationships along the way. Find a home for your career here. Join us and embrace a culture of **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Director of Operations is responsible for the overall organization, financial management, and operational leadership of one or more home health care centers. This role provides strategic and operational oversight to ensure regulatory compliance, quality patient care, business growth, fiscal performance, and staff development, while supervising clinical leadership and supporting interdisciplinary care delivery.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Handles employment decisions for direct report staff, including decisions to hire, fire, advance, promote or change status
* Responsible for overall organization and financial management of the care center
* Provides supervision to the clinical manager(s) who ensure the delivery of quality care to patients
* Maintains the image of the care center in the community, as well as state and national organizations
* Provides input, guidance and feedback related to marketing activities and care center marketing plan to ensure that goals for growth are met
* Ensures adequate orientation of every team member assigned to their care center
* Assigns and directs staff with appropriate skills to perform duties
* Provides leadership planning for staff education programs, administrative/staff meetings, in services
* Encourages continuous education and staff development for all team members. Sets positive, attainable expectations, objectives and goals for the care center
* Ensures implementation of a performance improvement program to drive quality care, positive patient outcomes, and address negative trends
* Responsible for the delivery of care for all patients served by the care centers by providing supervision and support to the clinical manager
* Other duties as assigned

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree in business or related clinical field
* 2+ years of home care experience and at least 1+ years of supervisory experience; or 2+ years of experience in leadership/management in healthcare, home health or hospice

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business or clinical related-field with a current license
* Current license to practice as an RN or other healthcare professional, specific to the state you're assigned to work
* Home health experience

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $90,880 to $136,320 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

card.title: Director Destination Care Operations
card.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

The Director of Destination Care Operations drives the day-to-day operational success of CommonSpirit Health’s destination care program in partnership with clinical, financial, and internal and external stakeholders – serving patients traveling 150 or more miles for specialty care, from neighboring communities across the United States to international markets. The Director advances program performance, team excellence, and a concierge-caliber patient experience, ensuring every patient experiences frictionless care from first inquiry through return home. This role is suited to a self-driven leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and brings strong team leadership, process improvement skills, and comfort leading teams through change. The ideal candidate leads with adaptability, resourcefulness, and a collaborative spirit, and is deeply committed to delivering an exceptional experience for every destination care patient. This is an in-person, onsite role.

* Oversees the day-to-day operational performance of the destination care program, ensuring consistent and high-quality service delivery across all phases of the patient journey. Oversees referral intake and coordination workflows, ensuring timely and accurate routing, follow-up, and communication with referring providers and patients.
* Ensures patients, families, and referring partners experience seamless, concierge-caliber service from initial contact through post-discharge follow-up; conducts regular patient and family rounding to assess experience, identify service gaps and recovery opportunities, reinforce service standards, and gather patient stories that reflect the destination care experience.
* Delivers and ensures culturally informed service, communication, and care coordination across diverse domestic and international patient populations. Partners with clinical leadership and clinical advisory resources to support patient care operations and ensure the clinical needs of the destination care population are addressed. Identifies and leads process improvement and workflow optimization initiatives to advance operational efficiency, service quality, and patient satisfaction; develops and maintains operational protocols and standards that support consistent program delivery.
* Establishes and maintains documentation standards and data integrity practices across the team to support accurate program reporting, operational decision-making, and continuity of patient care. Serves as the escalation point for the team and provides availability for complex or time-sensitive situations as they arise. Manages the destination care program budget and is accountable for financial performance against established targets.
* Sets clear performance expectations, invests in professional growth, and builds and sustains a high-performing team culture grounded in service excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement; establishes clear standards and ensures consistent adherence across the team, addressing performance gaps directly and constructively.
* Oversees onboarding, cross-training, and workflow consistency across the program. Leads change management efforts within the team to support adoption of new workflows, service standards, and program initiatives.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* Bachelors Other Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field. and 5 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, upon hire and
* Experience managing and developing teams in a complex, matrixed healthcare organization, with direct accountability for program performance outcomes, upon hire and
* Experience delivering high-touch, patient-centered services for complex or high-acuity patient populations, including programs such as transplant, oncology, specialty referral, or equivalent tertiary or quaternary care settings, upon hire and
* Experience with electronic health record and hospital information systems; proficiency with productivity suites including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office., upon hire or

Preferred

* Masters Other Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Nursing, or a related field and 7-9 years 7 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, upon hire and
* Experience with international patient programs, embassy-sponsored care, or global sponsor coordination., upon hire and
* Clinical background including Registered Nurse (RN) licensure or equivalent clinical operations experience, upon hire and
* Experience in a dedicated destination care, international patient services, or specialty referral program at an academic medical center or large health system, upon hire and
* Experience building or expanding programs, including policy and operational protocol development, upon hire and
* Experience preparing and delivering financial and operating performance reports and presentations for leadership, upon hire and
* Experience with referral management, patient access, financial counseling, registration, or admissions workflows, upon hire and
* Experience managing program operations across multiple facilities or markets within a large health system., upon hire
* Certified Case Manager, upon hire or
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certification, upon hire or
* Project Management Professional, upon hire or
* Registered Nurse: TX, upon hire

Where You'll Work

Baylor St. Luke’s Medical Center is an 1,045 bed facility located in the Texas medical center. A joint venture with Baylor College of Medicine, Baylor St. Luke’s is an internationally recognized leader in research and clinical excellence that has given rise to breakthroughs in cardiovascular care, neuroscience, oncology, transplantation, and more. The hospital is home to the Dan L Duncan Comprehensive Cancer Center, a nationally-accredited and NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center. Our new McNair Campus is designed around the human experience—modeled on evidence-based practices for the safety of patients, visitors, staff, and physicians. The 27.5-acre campus represents the future of healthcare through a transformative alliance focused on leading-edge patient care, research, and education.

 **Pay Range** 
$60.24 - $89.60 /hour

card.title: Director, Service Operations Trade Compliance Operations
card.description:
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Director of Service Operations Trade Compliance Operations to lead our world-class trade compliance operations across our global service supply chain. This is an outstanding opportunity to ensure that service parts, replacement systems, and returned products move across borders flawlessly while supporting our customer and factory commitments.

 

This role is key to the daily management and continuous refinement of trade compliance related to return material authorization (RMA), repair, replacement, refurbishment, and service inventory movements. You’ll partner with Legal, Global Trade, Service Planning, Logistics, warehouse teams, and service providers to convert requirements into clear, reliable processes.

 

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead trade compliance execution across service fulfillment, including international returns, repairs, replacements, cross-border transfers, and movements to and from third-party facilities.
* Establish consistent procedures for transaction screening, license verification, shipping documentation, customs clearance, and recordkeeping.
* Partner with Legal and Global Trade to apply export control and customs requirements to service transactions, including end-user, end-use, destination, and product eligibility reviews.
* Help service teams use accurate product classifications, country-of-origin information, and customs values for returned, repaired, refurbished, and replacement products.
* Build compliance checks into receiving, RMA processing, inventory transfers, outbound fulfillment, and disposition workflows.
Lead operational reviews, audits, and corrective actions to strengthen controls and prevent recurring issues. 

 

**What we need to see:**

* A bachelor’s degree in supply chain, international business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in trade compliance, customs, international logistics, or service supply chain operations, including 5+ years managing teams or complex programs.
* Understanding of RMA, repair, replacement, refurbishment, and service inventory procedures.
* Experience managing trade documentation, customs broker performance, shipment exceptions, and operational compliance controls.
The ability to translate regulatory mentorship into clear procedures, training, and system requirements. 

 

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience managing cross-border repair and return programs, including temporary imports and exports, duty relief, and returned-goods processes.
* Familiarity with SAP, SAP Global Trade Services, warehouse management, or transportation management systems.
Experience improving trade compliance across third-party warehouses, repair centers, and global service networks. 

 

This is your chance to join a team that strives for excellence and innovation in everything we do!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 232,500 USD – 435,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 24, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

card.title: Product Operations Director
card.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Operations to oversee daily product operations, manage the team, and optimize internal processes. This role requires close collaboration across departments to ensure the orderly progression of projects, address operational challenges, and contribute to the achievement of business objectives.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in team management, workflow optimization, and collaborating with senior leadership.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily product operations, ensuring that all tasks are completed according to plan.

Manage team performance, assign responsibilities, and support the professional development of team members.

Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to coordinate task prioritization.

Evaluate existing processes and implement optimizations or improvements where necessary.

Monitor operational performance and provide regular progress reports to management.

Identify potential project risks and work with the team to resolve issues as they arise.

Support product planning and assist the team in achieving business goals.

Maintain effective communication with internal teams and various stakeholders.

Requirements

20+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, or a related field.

Proven track record in team management and overseeing multiple projects.

In-depth understanding of product strategy and operational processes.

Experience in optimizing workflows and managing team performance.

Excellent communication, organizational, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

Strong cross-functional collaboration abilities, with the capacity to effectively navigate shifting priorities.

Experience in the Fintech or financial services industry is highly preferred.

Pay: $285,000.00 - $355,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
